xBRIEFInfo.description: Fail closed when completing code-bearing scopes without proof the implementation reached the configured delivery branch.

plan.title: bug(scope,swarm): completion succeeds without proof that implementation reached the delivery branch

narratives.Description: scope:complete / swarm:complete-cohort / swarm:finalize-cohort treat merge-to-any-base as delivered. Add deliveryBranch distinct from baseBranch, require ancestry of merge commit from remote delivery ref before delivered completion, and keep deployment/UAT as separate evidence axes.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer operator, I want completed scopes to require delivery-branch evidence, so that UAT is not greened by merges that only reached an integration branch.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add deliveryBranch as a typed plan.policy field distinct from swarm baseBranch. Gate packages/core/src/scope/transition.ts scope:complete for code-bearing scopes on durable delivery evidence (merge commit ancestor of refreshed remote delivery ref) or an explicit non-delivery disposition. Update packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort.ts to validate merged_at, base.ref, merge_commit_sha, and delivery-branch reachability; update complete-cohort.ts to refuse sweep without per-story evidence. Extend finalize-cohort.test.ts and scope transition tests for intermediate-branch rejection, refresh failure, and missing PR. Run pnpm exec vitest packages/core/src/scope packages/core/src/swarm and task check. Cite #3041 in CHANGELOG.md. Deploy/UAT remain separate non-inferred fields.
narratives.Overview: Delivery-integrity gate: completed != merged-to-integration; require delivery-branch reachability.
narratives.NonGoals: Auto-merge/deploy; treating PR-open as delivered; replacing deploy/UAT tooling; dirty-worktree recovery (#2849).

items.title: Delivery-evidence gate on scope:complete and cohort complete

narrative.Acceptance: Given a code-bearing active scope whose PR merged only to a non-delivery base, when scope:complete or swarm:complete-cohort runs without an explicit non-delivery disposition, the transition fails closed and the xBRIEF stays non-delivered.

Given swarm:finalize-cohort for a PR with merged_at set, when base.ref is not the configured deliveryBranch or merge_commit_sha is not an ancestor of the refreshed remote delivery ref, finalization fails closed; when it is on deliveryBranch and ancestry holds, finalization succeeds and records completion provenance metadata.

items.title: Separate baseBranch vs deliveryBranch + tests + CHANGELOG

narrative.Acceptance: Given project policy, baseBranch and deliveryBranch are independent typed concepts; tests cover direct delivery merge, intermediate merge rejection, stale remote refresh failure, and missing PR data; CHANGELOG cites #3041.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/scope packages/core/src/swarm
swarm.missing_traces_justification: Issue body locks acceptance and code coordinates (scope/transition, finalize-cohort, complete-cohort); file_scope is expected touch set for implementation.
